140:     # 多走两拍排空最后PV；空组仅走控制分支，不读plan或环槽。
141:     for qk_tick in pl.range(qk_block_count + QK_PRE_LAUNCH):
142:         if qk_tick < qk_block_count:
143:             qk_sb = qk_tick % SPARSE_BLOCKS
144:             qk_t = qk_core + (qk_tick // SPARSE_BLOCKS) * CORE_GROUPS
145:             if qk_sb == 0:
146:                 qk_q = pl.gather_row(qk_q, q_flat, [0, 0], [qk_t * H, 0], [H, HEAD_DIM])
147:             if pl.read(valid_block_mask, [qk_t, qk_sb]) > 0:
148:                 qk_slot = qk_core * QK_TRANSFER_SLOTS + qk_tick % QK_TRANSFER_SLOTS
149:                 qk_kv_row = qk_slot * ATTN_K_TILE
150:                 qk_transfer_row = qk_slot * H
151:                 pl.system.sync_wait(EVENT_BASE + QK_KV_READY_EVENT, pipe=pl.PipeType.MTE2, core_type=pl.KernelType.AIC)
152:                 qk_l1_row = (qk_tick % QK_TRANSFER_SLOTS) * ATTN_K_TILE
153:                 qk_l1 = pl.gather_row(qk_l1, kv_transfer, [qk_l1_row, 0], [qk_kv_row, 0], [ATTN_K_TILE, HEAD_DIM])
154:                 qk_l1_t = pl.tile.transpose_view(qk_l1)
155:                 qk_kv_t = pl.tile.slice(qk_l1_t, [HEAD_DIM, ATTN_K_TILE], [0, qk_l1_row])
156:                 qk_scores = pl.matmul(qk_q, qk_kv_t, out_dtype=pl.FP32)
157:                 pl.store(qk_scores, [qk_transfer_row, 0], score_transfer)
158:                 pl.system.sync_set(
159:                     EVENT_BASE + QK_SCORE_READY_EVENT, pipe=pl.PipeType.FIX, ffts_mode=2, core_type=pl.KernelType.AIC
160:                 )

162:             pv_work = qk_tick - QK_PRE_LAUNCH
163:             pv_sb = pv_work % SPARSE_BLOCKS
164:             pv_t = qk_core + (pv_work // SPARSE_BLOCKS) * CORE_GROUPS
165:             if pl.read(valid_block_mask, [pv_t, pv_sb]) > 0:
166:                 pv_slot = qk_core * QK_TRANSFER_SLOTS + pv_work % QK_TRANSFER_SLOTS
167:                 pv_transfer_row = pv_slot * H
168:                 pl.system.sync_wait(
169:                     EVENT_BASE + QK_PROB_READY_EVENT, pipe=pl.PipeType.MTE2, core_type=pl.KernelType.AIC
170:                 )
171:                 pv_probability = pl.load(
172:                     probability_transfer,
173:                     [pv_transfer_row, 0],
174:                     [H, ATTN_K_TILE],
175:                     target_memory=pl.MemorySpace.Mat,
176:                 )
177:                 pv_l1_row = (pv_work % QK_TRANSFER_SLOTS) * ATTN_K_TILE
178:                 # PV沿用N128/K128，保留每128候选一次softmax和query流水顺序。
179:                 pv_probability_left = pl.tile.move(pv_probability, target_memory=pl.MemorySpace.Left)
180:                 pv_first_right = pl.tile.extract(
181:                     qk_l1, pv_l1_row, 0, [ATTN_K_TILE, PV_N_TILE], target_memory=pl.MemorySpace.Right
182:                 )
183:                 pv_previous = pl.tile.matmul(pv_probability_left, pv_first_right)
184:                 for pv_n in pl.unroll(1, HEAD_DIM // PV_N_TILE):
185:                     pv_next_right = pl.tile.extract(
186:                         qk_l1,
187:                         pv_l1_row,
188:                         pv_n * PV_N_TILE,
189:                         [ATTN_K_TILE, PV_N_TILE],
190:                         target_memory=pl.MemorySpace.Right,
191:                     )
192:                     # 同时保留前后两个累加器，让前块FIX写回与后块Cube重叠。
193:                     pv_current = pl.tile.matmul(pv_probability_left, pv_next_right)
194:                     pl.store(pv_previous, [pv_transfer_row, (pv_n - 1) * PV_N_TILE], pv_transfer)
195:                     pv_previous = pv_current
196:                 pl.store(pv_previous, [pv_transfer_row, HEAD_DIM - PV_N_TILE], pv_transfer)
197:                 pl.system.sync_set(
198:                     EVENT_BASE + QK_PV_READY_EVENT, pipe=pl.PipeType.FIX, ffts_mode=2, core_type=pl.KernelType.AIC
199:                 )
